addressed.claim_id: Fixed intra-group payment_ids sort from (id, date) to (date, id) per Rule 11
Fixed group ordering to use earliest date in group plus first id of correctly sorted payment_ids per Rule 11

Amount scale validation now inspects Decimal exponent (rejecting scale > 2 regardless of trailing zeroes like "10.000"/"10.1000", accounting for exponent notation) instead of `amount != amount.quantize(_CENT)`.

Removed context-precision-dependent `quantize` from validation and performed final group-amount quantization under a `localcontext` with precision sufficient for the operand to avoid spurious `InvalidOperation` on large valid amounts.
